changes: Reworked support as private modmail channels. `/ticket create` now offers Java, Bedrock, Report User, Report Bug, Partnership, Management, and Staff Apply.
Added `/ticket close`, `delete`, `reopen`, `claim`, `transfer`, and `availability`. Managers can turn new requests on or off for each type; all types are on by default.
Fixed `/ticket ping`: use `state:on|off` in a modmail channel or `hours:<number>` to check idle conversations.
Updated `/rules` with a dropdown that shows one rule at a time and links to current Discord, Minecraft, and TheySix resources.
Fixed `/wiki article` search for the current TheySix Wiki domain and added the wiki homepage as an index fallback.
Improved the `/learn` command with a new `/learn review` option to generate reviewed local wiki drafts.
Closing modmail now saves full local transcripts and a combined JSONL corpus. Java, Bedrock, and bug reports can produce reviewed local wiki drafts with `/learn review`.
